name: Document Analysis
description: A goal-driven report for PDF, text, Markdown, and chunked document sources that emphasizes subjects, claims, evidence, relationships, and limitations.

data_requirements.description: Materialize evidence from the actual document content that is sufficient to answer the user's objective.
calculation_hints: Preserve text and source locations needed to identify the subject, main claims, arguments, sections, relationships, and limitations.
Include bounded supporting excerpts or locations for consequential findings.
Do not substitute page, chunk, word, or character counts for content evidence.

fallback.message: Explain that readable content evidence is unavailable.

sections.title: Overview
sections.purpose: Answer the objective and surface the most important content findings immediately.

blocks.title: Executive Summary
instructions: Lead with the document's subject, purpose, and direct answer to the user objective.
Synthesize the strongest evidence-backed findings in no more than five sentences.
Do not lead with extraction or file-size statistics.

blocks.title: Key Findings
instructions: Present distinct, evidence-backed findings as concise scan-friendly items.
Prefer claims, relationships, implications, and limitations over metadata.

sections.title: Data at a Glance
sections.purpose: Provide four dynamically selected overview measures for the analyzed evidence.

blocks.title: Overview
instructions: Show exactly four dynamically selected metrics in the supplied order.
Prefer objective-relevant measures and use structural measures to complete the overview.

sections.title: Focused Analysis
sections.purpose: Pair one meaningful visual comparison with interpretation when quantitative evidence exists.

blocks.title: Evidence Comparison

chart_slot.intent: Visualize the most informative objective-relevant comparison supported by the document.

fallback.message: No meaningful quantitative comparison is available.

instructions: Use only evidence that helps answer the objective.

blocks.title: Interpretation
instructions: Explain what the evidence means and any material caveats.
Do not narrate chart mechanics or repeat labels.

sections.title: Evidence and Caveats
sections.purpose: Ground the report in source evidence and state important limitations.

blocks.title: Supporting Evidence
instructions: Connect major findings to available excerpts, sections, or source locations.
Paraphrase by default and keep quotations brief.

blocks.title: Limitations and Next Questions
instructions: State only limitations supported by extraction coverage or evidence gaps.
Suggest next questions only when they follow from the findings.
